text: ok that is better. now, there is a problem where cars are just driving in the middle of the road / offset in their lane. because lanes are a fixed width of 3 tiles, cars should effectively always path in the center tile down the road
resolution: Cars drove offset within / down the middle of the road because lanes are 3-tile-wide directional trios but the BFS routed cell-to-cell across the trio's width. Now every route cell is snapped onto its lane CENTERLINE before simplification: scan perpendicular to the cell's flow to find the same-flow trio span, take its midpoint. All three tiles of a trio share the trio's flow, so they snap to one centered line → the car drives dead-center; junctions/crosswalks keep their own center. Replaced integer collapseCollinear with a world-space simplifyPolyline. New P4 test on a 3-wide ring asserts top-band points land on the center tile (z=1.5), never edges. 6/6 traffic tests; re-baked + self-shot. SHA dea0647c7.
